motive.canonical: Silas Thorne discovered Beatrice Lowell had been stealing from the cafe till and gave him until this morning to confess before he took the proof to the village committee.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the Brass till weight, in the storage room.

opportunity.canonical: Beatrice Lowell was at the cafe's rear door during the murder window and lied about being at the fountain.

explanation: Correct. Beatrice Lowell killed Silas Thorne. Silas Thorne had found the torn ledger page proving Beatrice Lowell was skimming the till, and gave him until this morning to confess before taking it to the committee. He summoned him to the storage room before opening. Beatrice Lowell slipped out the front, doubled back through the silas thorne's house — the blue coat someone saw at 10:43 — and let himself in the back door. When Silas Thorne refused to back down he struck him with the Brass till weight at 10:52 (the thud someone and someone heard), rinsed it in the kitchen and hid it in the mop bucket, then opened the cafe two minutes late. His fountain alibi was never real, and no one could place him there.
